registrationPreconditions: Exact fresh original row and business preimage; planned/plan_only/attempts0 and all nonexecuting safety flags.
Zero job/resource/capacity/schedule/step references under one transaction with the deployment locked; serialize with every future reference writer.
Permanent row and reference guards are installed and independently inspected before registration can commit.
A separate fresh single-row registration approval binds complete original bytes, approved schema guards and exact target; no design hash is execution permission.

permanentGuardTargets.app_instance_deployments: Reject UPDATE/DELETE of a sealed original deployment; do not change or replace the existing immutable environment/instance trigger.
permanentGuardTargets.deployment_jobs: Reject INSERT/UPDATE targeting the sealed deployment_id.
permanentGuardTargets.deployment_tenant_resources: Reject INSERT/UPDATE when either owner_deployment_id or created_by_deployment_id references a sealed deployment.
permanentGuardTargets.deployment_environment_capacity_reservat: Reject INSERT/UPDATE targeting the sealed deployment_id.
permanentGuardTargets.deployment_cleanup_schedules: Reject INSERT/UPDATE targeting the sealed deployment_id.
permanentGuardTargets.deployment_step_runs: Reject INSERT/UPDATE targeting the sealed deployment_id.
permanentGuardTargets.deployment_plan_only_isolations: Reject UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE; registration is separate, scope-bound and not available to the Worker.

ownershipSnapshotContract.nonterminalDeploymentSet: Only the exact permanently sealed deployment can be classified non-owning after original bytes and installed guard proof match. No generic mode/cell_key/status filter.
ownershipSnapshotContract.activeTenantSet: Retain every pending/active instance with any unsealed deployment in the target environment. A sole valid sealed legacy record may be classified non-owning; a future new deployment on the same instance must restore membership.
ownershipSnapshotContract.capacityResourceAndScheduleSets: Existing complete ownership queries remain unchanged; a certificate must never hide a live reservation, created/owned resource or nonterminal schedule.
ownershipSnapshotContract.snapshotHash: Include all sealed certificates, guard/schema proof, admission fence and every ownership set in the new versioned source hash.
ownershipSnapshotContract.authorityAndDeletionIntegration: Separately versioned proof adapters must bind the full new source hash before a Cell cleanup plan can be approved. An empty filtered array is not evidence.

negativeProofsRequiredBeforeActivation: Concurrency: reference writer racing registration must either remain visible and block registration or fail after sealing; no unlocked check-then-insert.
New live deployment on the retained instance remains visible to admission and zero-tenant gates.
Changed/deleted original row, changed plan bytes, missing/disabled/bypassed guards or an unknown schema checksum fail closed.
Any live resource/reservation/nonterminal schedule still blocks cleanup, even with a valid sealed certificate.
Old schema2 source and both existing deletion roots reject the candidate schema3 envelope until explicit versioned integration is implemented.
